label: Secrets
description: Browser-local named secrets encrypted by a random data encryption key. The master password and WebAuthn PRF passkeys independently wrap the same key.

credentials.description: Master-password credentials. Passwords are used transiently and are never persisted or logged.

unlockCredentials.description: Master-password credentials and an optional remembered-session duration.

passkeyEnrollment.description: Passkey label, optional plaintext description, and master password used to reauthenticate enrollment.

passkeySelection.description: Optional local passkey selection. Omitting id lets WebAuthn select among registered credentials.

passkeyInfo.description: Safe metadata for a local passkey registration.

description.description: Plaintext descriptive metadata. Never use this field for sensitive data.

secretInfo.description: Metadata describing a stored secret. The description is encrypted at rest.

secretMetadata.description: Optional metadata to apply while storing a secret. Omitting description preserves the current description.

passkeyMetadata.description: Editable plaintext metadata for a passkey registration.

sessionRestoreResult.description: Result of a remembered-session restoration attempt.

status.description: Current vault status. A reload starts locked unless an eligible remembered session is restored.

rememberMinutes.description: Configured default remembered-session duration in minutes.

maxRememberMinutes.description: Configured maximum remembered-session duration in minutes.

sessionExpiresAt.description: Absolute UTC expiration of the active remembered session, or null for a memory-only or locked session.

ready.description: Waits for IndexedDB discovery and the automatic remembered-session restoration attempt, then returns the current status.

restoreSession.description: Safely attempts to restore the current tab's remembered session without requesting a password, deriving a password key, or invoking WebAuthn.

initialize.description: Creates a V2 vault with a random 256-bit data encryption key, wraps it with the master password, and leaves the vault unlocked. Never overwrites existing metadata.

unlock.description: Authenticates the password-wrapped data encryption key and unlocks the vault. The optional duration must be allowed by application policy; zero is memory-only. An invalid password never modifies storage.

unlockWithPasskey.description: Uses a registered credential's WebAuthn PRF result to authenticate and unwrap the data encryption key. The optional duration must be allowed by application policy. Fails without PRF output and never falls back to password unlocking.

lock.description: Immediately invalidates the active session, revokes remembered access for the current tab, aborts active storage writes, and discards the in-memory data encryption key reference.

list.description: Lists secret identifiers and metadata without exposing values. Requires an unlocked vault.

get.description: Decrypts and returns a secret, or undefined if absent. Requires an unlocked vault.

getInfo.description: Returns decrypted metadata for a secret, or undefined if absent. Requires an unlocked vault.

set.description: Encrypts a JSON value and optional description with the random data encryption key and fresh IVs. Omitting description preserves an existing description. Requires an unlocked vault.

delete.description: Removes a secret if present. Requires an unlocked vault.

addPasskey.description: Reauthenticates with the master password, registers a PRF-capable passkey, and stores an independent wrapping of the same data encryption key. Requires an unlocked vault and user interaction.

listPasskeys.description: Lists safe local registration metadata without cryptographic material. Does not require an unlocked vault.

updatePasskey.description: Updates only the plaintext descriptive metadata of a local passkey registration. Requires an unlocked vault.

removePasskey.description: Removes one local passkey wrapping without changing secrets, other passkeys, or master-password recovery. Requires an unlocked vault.

secrets:status-changed.description: Emitted after the vault lifecycle state or active remembered-session expiration changes.
